ashley: Postmortem follow-up: recurring pattern = routing thrash + delayed snapshot availability. Consolidating owners and quick ETAs.

ashley: Action list:
- stabilize weighted routing + fallback (owner: mike)
- nightly manifest verification job (owner: yara)
- restore runbook clarity + TTR targets (owner: tony)
- schedule a dry-run game-day (owner: ashley)

mike: Ill take routing. Plan: add route health score smoothing + fallback cooldown. Need approval for additional probe endpoint. ETA 2026-04-08.

yara: Ill build a small verification job that reads manifests and checks checksums; will emit a weekly report. Need S3 read role. ETA 2026-03-29.
tony: Updating runbook to include explicit warmup steps and a <90m restore target for staging. Will add checklist and abort criteria. ETA 2026-03-31.
ashley: Ill set the game-day for 2026-04-09 in a prod-like stack and invite SRE + infra. Ops-bot, can you add a reminder one day prior?

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Game-day prep on 2026-04-08 09:00 UTC.

mike: Draft circuit-breaker config:
- errors/min threshold: 8
- cooldown: 45s
- degrade: regional-fallback

yara: Sample verification output to include in runbook:
OK snapshot-2026-03-21.manifest checksums OK
ERR snapshot-2026-03-20.manifest missing-chunk: 4

ashley: Please create JIRA tickets with label dr-action and post links here. We'll review progress at next DR sync.

mike: Ticket DR-4990 created.
yara: Ticket DR-4991 created.
tony: Ticket DR-4992 created.
ashley: Thanks everyone. If blockers arise, update tickets and ping this thread.
